<?php
/**
 * Session Token Management Service
 * Handles secure session creation, validation, and revocation
 * Uses Redis for session storage with strict token format validation
 */

class SessionConfig {
    const TOKEN_TTL = 3600;
    const MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER = 5;
    const REDIS_PREFIX = 'sess:';

    /**
     * Retrieve the HMAC key from a secure runtime source (environment /
     * secrets manager) instead of hard-coding it in source control.
     */
    public static function getTokenHmacKey(): string {
        $key = getenv('TOKEN_HMAC_KEY');
        if ($key === false || $key === '') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('TOKEN_HMAC_KEY is not configured');
        }
        return $key;
    }
}

class TokenValidator {
    /**
     * Validates session token format before any operation.
     * Tokens must be exactly 64 hex characters (256-bit).
     * This validation is applied at every read/write boundary.
     */
    public static function isValidTokenFormat(string $token): bool {
        // Strict format: exactly 64 hex chars, anchored with \z
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}\z/', $token);
    }

    /**
     * Validates session ID format for Redis key construction.
     * Session IDs are user-provided and used in Redis key paths.
     * Format: alphanumeric with hyphens, 8-64 chars.
     */
    public static function isValidSessionId(string $sessionId): bool {
        // Allow alphanumeric, hyphens, 8-64 length
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{8,64}\z/', $sessionId);
    }
}

class RedisSessionStore {
    private $redis;

    public function __construct(\Redis $redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }

    /**
     * Constructs Redis key from session ID.
     * Session ID is validated before reaching this point.
     */
    private function buildKey(string $sessionId): string {
        return SessionConfig::REDIS_PREFIX . $sessionId;
    }

    public function store(string $sessionId, array $data, int $ttl): bool {
        $key = $this->buildKey($sessionId);
        $serialized = json_encode($data);
        return $this->redis->setex($key, $ttl, $serialized);
    }

    public function retrieve(string $sessionId): ?array {
        $key = $this->buildKey($sessionId);
        $data = $this->redis->get($key);
        if ($data === false) return null;
        return json_decode($data, true);
    }

    public function delete(string $sessionId): bool {
        $key = $this->buildKey($sessionId);
        return (bool) $this->redis->del($key);
    }

    public function getUserSessions(string $userId): array {
        $pattern = SessionConfig::REDIS_PREFIX . 'user:' . $userId . ':*';
        return $this->redis->keys($pattern);
    }
}

class SessionService {
    private RedisSessionStore $store;
    private AuditLogger $audit;

    public function __construct(RedisSessionStore $store, AuditLogger $audit) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->audit = $audit;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new session for authenticated user.
     * Generates cryptographically secure token.
     */
    public function createSession(string $userId, array $metadata): array {
        if (!$this->isValidUserId($userId)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid user ID format');
        }

        // Generate secure random token
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $sessionId = 'user:' . $userId . ':' . $token;

        $sessionData = [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'token' => $token,
            'created_at' => time(),
            'expires_at' => time() + SessionConfig::TOKEN_TTL,
            'ip' => $metadata['ip'] ?? 'unknown',
            'user_agent' => substr($metadata['user_agent'] ?? '', 0, 256),
            'fingerprint' => $this->computeFingerprint($metadata),
        ];

        // Enforce max sessions
        $this->enforceSessionLimit($userId);

        $this->store->store($sessionId, $sessionData, SessionConfig::TOKEN_TTL);
        $this->audit->log('session_created', $userId, ['session_prefix' => substr($token, 0, 8)]);

        return ['token' => $token, 'expires_in' => SessionConfig::TOKEN_TTL];
    }

    /**
     * Validates a session token and returns session data if valid.
     * Token format is strictly validated before any lookup.
     */
    public function validateSession(string $userId, string $token): ?array {
        if (!$this->isValidUserId($userId)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Validate token format at the point of use
        if (!TokenValidator::isValidTokenFormat($token)) {
            $this->audit->log('invalid_token_format', $userId, ['token_prefix' => substr($token, 0, 4)]);
            return null;
        }

        $sessionId = 'user:' . $userId . ':' . $token;
        $session = $this->store->retrieve($sessionId);

        if ($session === null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Check expiration
        if (($session['expires_at'] ?? 0) < time()) {
            $this->store->delete($sessionId);
            return null;
        }

        // Verify token matches (defense in depth)
        if (!hash_equals($session['token'], $token)) {
            $this->audit->log('token_mismatch', $userId, []);
            return null;
        }

        return $session;
    }

    /**
     * Revokes a specific session.
     */
    public function revokeSession(string $userId, string $token): bool {
        if (!$this->isValidUserId($userId)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TokenValidator::isValidTokenFormat($token)) {
            return false;
        }

        $sessionId = 'user:' . $userId . ':' . $token;
        $result = $this->store->delete($sessionId);
        
        if ($result) {
            $this->audit->log('session_revoked', $userId, ['token_prefix' => substr($token, 0, 8)]);
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Revokes all sessions for a user (e.g., password change).
     */
    public function revokeAllSessions(string $userId): int {
        if (!$this->isValidUserId($userId)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $sessions = $this->store->getUserSessions($userId);
        $count = 0;
        foreach ($sessions as $key) {
            $this->store->delete(str_replace(SessionConfig::REDIS_PREFIX, '', $key));
            $count++;
        }

        $this->audit->log('all_sessions_revoked', $userId, ['count' => $count]);
        return $count;
    }

    private function isValidUserId(string $userId): bool {
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]{4,32}\z/', $userId);
    }

    private function enforceSessionLimit(string $userId): void {
        $sessions = $this->store->getUserSessions($userId);
        if (count($sessions) >= SessionConfig::MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER) {
            // Remove oldest session
            $oldest = $sessions[0] ?? null;
            if ($oldest) {
                $this->store->delete(str_replace(SessionConfig::REDIS_PREFIX, '', $oldest));
            }
        }
    }

    private function computeFingerprint(array $metadata): string {
        $components = [
            $metadata['ip'] ?? '',
            $metadata['user_agent'] ?? '',
            $metadata['accept_language'] ?? '',
        ];
        return hash_hmac('sha256', implode('|', $components), SessionConfig::getTokenHmacKey());
    }
}

/**
 * HTTP API Controller for session management.
 * Handles request parsing and delegates to SessionService.
 */
class SessionController {
    private SessionService $service;

    public function __construct(SessionService $service) {
        $this->service = $service;
    }

    /**
     * POST /api/sessions - Create new session
     */
    public function handleCreate(array $request): array {
        $userId = $request['user_id'] ?? '';
        $metadata = [
            'ip' => $request['remote_addr'] ?? '0.0.0.0',
            'user_agent' => $request['user_agent'] ?? '',
            'accept_language' => $request['accept_language'] ?? '',
        ];

        try {
            $result = $this->service->createSession($userId, $metadata);
            return ['status' => 201, 'data' => $result];
        } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    /**
     * GET /api/sessions/validate - Validate existing session
     */
    public function handleValidate(array $request): array {
        $userId = $request['user_id'] ?? '';
        $token = $request['token'] ?? '';

        $session = $this->service->validateSession($userId, $token);

        if ($session) {
            return ['status' => 200, 'data' => ['valid' => true, 'user_id' => $session['user_id']]];
        }
        return ['status' => 401, 'data' => ['valid' => false]];
    }

    /**
     * DELETE /api/sessions - Revoke session
     */
    public function handleRevoke(array $request): array {
        $userId = $request['user_id'] ?? '';
        $token = $request['token'] ?? '';

        $result = $this->service->revokeSession($userId, $token);
        return ['status' => $result ? 200 : 404, 'data' => ['revoked' => $result]];
    }
}

/**
 * Background job: processes session analytics.
 * Reads session data and generates usage reports.
 * Uses a separate validation path for batch processing.
 */
class SessionAnalyticsProcessor {
    private RedisSessionStore $store;
    private \PDO $db;

    public function __construct(RedisSessionStore $store, \PDO $db) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    /**
     * Process analytics for a batch of session events.
     * Events come from an internal Kafka topic (trusted source).
     */
    public function processBatch(array $events): void {
        foreach ($events as $event) {
            $this->processEvent($event);
        }
    }

    private function processEvent(array $event): void {
        $eventType = $event['type'] ?? '';
        $userId = $event['user_id'] ?? '';
        $sessionToken = $event['session_token'] ?? '';
        $timestamp = $event['timestamp'] ?? time();

        // Validate event data format
        if (!$this->isValidEventType($eventType)) {
            return;
        }

        if (!$this->isValidAnalyticsUserId($userId)) {
            return;
        }

        // Validate token format strictly using \z anchor
        if (!$this->isValidAnalyticsToken($sessionToken)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->recordAnalyticsEvent($eventType, $userId, $sessionToken, $timestamp);
    }

    private function isValidEventType(string $type): bool {
        return in_array($type, ['login', 'logout', 'refresh', 'expire', 'revoke'], true);
    }

    private function isValidAnalyticsUserId(string $userId): bool {
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]{4,32}\z/', $userId);
    }

    /**
     * Analytics token validation - allows historical token formats.
     * Current format: 64 hex chars
     * Legacy format: 32 hex chars  
     * Uses \z to ensure true end-of-string matching (no trailing newline bypass)
     */
    private function isValidAnalyticsToken(string $token): bool {
        // Accept current and legacy formats with strict \z anchor
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32,64}\z/', $token);
    }

    /**
     * Records analytics event to the reporting database.
     * Uses parameterized queries for all user-controlled data.
     */
    private function recordAnalyticsEvent(string $eventType, string $userId, string $sessionToken, int $timestamp): void {
        // Determine the partition table based on the month
        $month = date('Y_m', $timestamp);
        $table = $this->resolveAnalyticsTable($month);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} (event_type, user_id, session_token, event_time) VALUES (:type, :uid, :token, :etime)";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            ':type' => $eventType,
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':token' => $sessionToken,
            ':etime' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', $timestamp),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the analytics partition table name.
     * Tables are partitioned by month: analytics_events_2024_01, etc.
     */
    private function resolveAnalyticsTable(string $month): string {
        // Validate month format strictly with \z anchor
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}_\d{2}\z/', $month)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid month partition format');
        }
        return 'analytics_events_' . $month;
    }
}

class AuditLogger {
    public function log(string $action, string $userId, array $context): void {
        $entry = json_encode([
            'timestamp' => date('c'),
            'action' => $action,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'context' => $context,
        ]);
        error_log('[AUDIT] ' . $entry);
    }
}
